tokens.name: loop-blue
tokens.usage: Left lobe of the infinity mark (the machine). Brand fills and illustrations only, not text on light grounds (3.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: loop-yellow
tokens.usage: Right lobe of the infinity mark (the human). Brand fills only; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: nous-blue
tokens.usage: Brand ledger primary: 'the brain'. Deep brand blocks, the NousLoopIcon ring. White text on it passes (11:1).

tokens.name: nous-gold
tokens.usage: Brand ledger primary: 'the human / action'. Brand highlights; pair with nous-blue or wordmark-ink text.

tokens.name: nous-slate
tokens.usage: Brand ledger structure neutral. Also the Clinical theme's ink-dim.

tokens.name: wordmark-ink
tokens.usage: Colour of the 'nous loop' wordmark in the logo lockups.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white ground the logo lockups sit on. Marketing and print backgrounds.

tokens.name: nousloop-teal
tokens.usage: Nousloop website primary ('neon resistance teal', hsl 172 90% 55%). Web glow accents on near-black only.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Street layer: the black brick face. Ground for the brand wall, posters and the cover.

tokens.name: mortar
tokens.usage: Street layer: mortar lines between bricks. Never text.

tokens.name: neon-cyan
tokens.usage: Street layer: the sprayed ∞ and the NoUs tag, sampled from the campaign art. On brick: 15:1. Pair with glow-neon-cyan.

tokens.name: neon-blue
tokens.usage: Street layer: electric blue the live paint drifts into from neon-cyan. Blue on black is the core look. On brick: 6.3:1. Derived, not sampled.

tokens.name: neon-red
tokens.usage: Street layer: the X over 'our data', strike-throughs, the slash in 'severance/'. On brick: 5.9:1.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: App background (Sovereign: --bg-deep; Clinical: ledger 'Background Clinical').

tokens.name: surface-mid
tokens.usage: Rails, sidebars, headers (Sovereign: --bg-mid, the intel rail; Clinical: ledger 'Surface Panel').

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tab bars and command strips set below the canvas. Clinical value derived, not in source.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on the canvas (vital-card, roadmap-card). Always with a border.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Button and row background; hover adds a little more.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The one hairline: panels, inputs, dividers, rails. Clinical value derived.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Card border on hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and assistant messages. 19:1 / 16:1 on surface-deep.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, inactive tabs. 8:1 / 7.5:1 on surface-deep.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, offline dots, disabled. FLAG: below 4.5:1 in both themes (2.6:1 / 4.0:1), so never use it for text a person must read.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Sovereign signal: OK, connected, primary action, active tab, user messages, the λ prompt. Clinical value derived for text contrast (5.5:1).

tokens.name: emerald-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind emerald badges and the primary button.

tokens.name: emerald-line
tokens.usage: Border of emerald badges and the primary button.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Sentinel colour: warnings, in-progress, system messages, high neural load. Clinical value derived (5:1).

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind amber badges and warnings.

tokens.name: amber-line
tokens.usage: Border of amber badges and warnings.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Sensors: microphone active, info pulses. Clinical value derived.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed states. Clinical darkened from the ledger's Alert Red #e53e3e (4.0:1) to pass.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind error badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of error badges and alerts.

styles.name: tag-hero
styles.usage: Fallback for the wordmark when the SVG can't be used. The real wordmark is the hand-sprayed SVG (Wordmark component).

styles.name: tag-slogan
styles.usage: Slogans on the wall: lowercase, slash kept in neon-red, class nl-tag-text inside nl-live.

styles.name: tag-small
styles.usage: Stickers, captions, cover tagline. Never below 22px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your data stays here. Nothing leaves without you.

styles.name: command
styles.sample: λ tell me what to take back
styles.usage: The command bar input, in emerald (1.2rem).

styles.name: stream
styles.usage: Message stream in the intel rail (0.8rem, line-height 1.4).

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Vital labels and status badges, uppercase (0.6rem): the smallest size, only for short labels.
